if.notes: Executes block if condition evaluates to true.

elif.notes: Executes block if previous if/elif condition was false and this condition is true.

else.notes: Executes block if all preceding if/elif conditions were false.

for.notes: Loops through each element in an array or collection.

return.notes: Returns value from the function and terminates execution.

bmql.syntax: recordset bmql("SELECT column1, column2 FROM dataTable WHERE condition = $var");
bmql.notes: BigMachines Query Language (BMQL) - executes direct database SQL queries on CPQ Data Tables.

throwerror.notes: Stops script execution and raises a user-facing error message on CPQ UI.

print.notes: Prints value to the CPQ BML Function Editor execution log / console.
